newsitem.title: MEXICO: Carso Global Telecom says it will increase capital. [CORRECTED 00:59 GMT 02/10]
newsitem.headline: Carso Global Telecom says it will increase capital. [CORRECTED 00:59 GMT 02/10]

text.p: Carso Global Telecom said Tuesday it will increase its capital by 682.5 million pesos by issuing 35 million shares of its A1 series at a price of 19.50 pesos per share in a rights offering (corrects type of issue from a private placement) in the next two weeks.

"We will increase the capital of Carso Global by 35 million shares at a price of 19.50 pesos per share, which gives us a figure of 682.5 million pesos," Jaime Chico Pardo, president of the administrative council of Grupo Financiero Inbursa, told Reuters.
There are corporate links between Inbursa and Carso.
